task.pr_title: fix(header): collapsible header works in tabs

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: `ion-tab` is not a component thats available, so `this.el.closest('ion-tab')` will always return `null` here.

evidence.thread_resolution: liamdebeasi: Whoops, `ion-tab` is a component in vanilla JS Ionic, but not in `@ionic/angular`. Will fix, thanks.
